mapper.sql: id, `name`, `location`, start_date, end_date, sort, content, country, country_name, exhibition_type, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.continent_code, a.continent_name, a.country_code, a.country_name, COUNT(*) AS exhibition_count, SUM(e.end_date >= #{today}) AS upcoming_count FROM exhibition_detail e JOIN global_area a ON a.id = e.country GROUP BY a.id, a.continent_code, a.continent_name, a.country_code, a.country_name ORDER BY a.id
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(start_date) AS y FROM exhibition_detail ORDER BY y
